# RestGuiNodeFactory — UML and Use Cases

**Author / Workshop moniker:** @TrentBest  
**Target:** TheSingularityWorkshop.FSM_REST.GUI.RestGuiNodeFactory  
**Source:** [RestGuiNodeFactory.cs](../../src/FSM_REST.GUI/RestGuiNodeFactory.cs)  
**Provenance:** Manually authored and source-checked; not generated by reflection, AST analysis, or GUI.SVG.

## Purpose
Convert REST GUI mapping metadata into a renderer-neutral Workshop GUI tree. The factory is a structural adapter, not an HTTP executor or renderer.

## Target-centered class diagram

~~~mermaid
classDiagram
    direction TB
    class RestGuiMapping {
      +OperationId
      +Label
      +Presentation
      +Inputs
      +ResultTarget
      +ShowLoadingState
      +ShowErrorState
    }
    class RestGuiNodeFactory {
      <<static>>
      +GetCommandId(operationId) string
      +Create(mapping, nodeId) GuiNode
    }
    class GuiNode {
      <<Workshop GUI Core>>
      +Id
      +Kind
      +Properties
      +Children
    }
    class GuiBuilders {
      <<Workshop GUI Core>>
    }
    class GuiBuilder {
      <<Workshop GUI Core>>
    }
    class RestGuiInputMapping
    class RestGuiOperationExecutor

    RestGuiNodeFactory ..> RestGuiMapping : reads
    RestGuiMapping o-- RestGuiInputMapping : declares inputs
    RestGuiNodeFactory ..> GuiBuilders : builds panel, column, text, button
    RestGuiNodeFactory ..> GuiBuilder : builds semantic RestInput nodes
    RestGuiNodeFactory ..> GuiNode : returns tree
    GuiNode ..> RestGuiOperationExecutor : host dispatches command to
~~~

The final relationship is a use-case relationship: the host dispatches the emitted command identity; the factory does not call the executor.

## Use cases
1. **Build an operation panel.** A host supplies a mapping and stable node ID; the factory creates a panel, title, inputs, execute button, and optional result marker.
2. **Preserve input semantics.** Input nodes carry parameter identity and required status, plus optional source path and value-type hint.
3. **Dispatch the operation.** The button carries onClickCommand = fsm-rest:{operationId}. The host routes this to its execution handler.
4. **Keep dependencies clean.** Only the optional GUI adapter references Workshop GUI Core; the REST core remains independently consumable.

## Limitations
- The factory does not run a loading/error lifecycle or invoke result callbacks.
- RestInput is semantic metadata; this page does not claim every renderer implements it.
- Stable command identity is not authorization.
